pages.text: A safe that holds only Shatter Coins, 27 stacks of 12 per block. Nothing can pipe coins in or out.$(br2)Vault blocks of yours that touch join into one vault, up to 3 x 3 x 3. You may own 27 vault blocks.
The block keeps its lock and alarm when you break it and place it again.

On the $(l)Access$() tab, add the players who may open the vault. They must be online when you add them. They can move coins but cannot change the settings.$(br2)On the $(l)Security$() tab, buy up to three lock levels and an Alarm with coins. The Alarm warns everyone with access the moment someone starts picking the lock.
pages.title: Access and Security

pages.text: Anyone without access can pick the lock: 2 minutes, plus 1 minute for each lock level, staying within 4 blocks. If they finish, they take a quarter of the coins, chosen at random. Illyrium coins are safe while the vault holds 3 or fewer.$(br2)Breaking a vault that is not yours gives no coins: they are kept for the owner, who collects them by opening any vault of theirs.
pages.title: Lockpicking

pages.text: Coins in your vaults earn interest every day: XP levels and Tetrium Ingots for the coin value stored, counted across all your vaults on this server. Netherite and Illyrium coins also earn Illyrium Ingots: at least 2 every 3 days while you keep one.$(br2)Interest builds up while you are offline, but stops at 3 days' worth. Press $(l)Redeem$() on the Storage tab to collect it and start it building again.
pages.title: Interest

pages.text: The more coin value you keep, the better the rate. From 32 coin value everything pays half as much again, from 128 twice as much, and from 512 three times as much.$(br2)Before that, every 10 coin value earns 1 XP level and 3 Tetrium Ingots a day, and every 32 value in Netherite and Illyrium coins earns 1 Illyrium Ingot. A day pays at most 100 levels, 384 Tetrium and 4 Illyrium.
pages.title: Bigger hoards

pages.text: While your vaults hold 32 coin value or more, counting every server, you earn a $(l)prize roll$() every 12 hours, up to 6 waiting.$(br2)Each roll is a random item from the server's prize table, given when you press $(l)Redeem$(). The rarer the prize, the less often it comes up; when you win a rare one, the chat tells you the odds.$(br2)The vault's $(l)Interest$() tab shows your step, what you earn a day, what is waiting and when the next roll comes.
pages.title: Prize rolls
